algorithms.name: Amplitude Estimation
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Estimate the amplitude a using 3 precision qubits via quantum phase estimation.

algorithms.name: Job-Shop Scheduling (Annealing)
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Solve job-shop scheduling via annealing with QUBO encoding. Each job has ordered tasks assigned to machines with durations. Minimizes makespan (latest completion time). Real-world operations research problem used in manufacturing, logistics, and project management. Based on Venturelli et al., Physical Review X (2015).

algorithms.name: MaxCut (Annealing)
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Solve MaxCut graph partitioning via quantum/simulated annealing. Same problem as qaoa-maxcut but uses annealing instead of gate-based QAOA. Compare results across paradigms: gate-based (QAOA) vs annealing on the same graph. QUBO formulation: Q_{ij} = -w for cut edges.

algorithms.name: B92 Quantum Key Distribution
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Simulate the B92 QKD protocol (Bennett, 1992). A simplified version of BB84 using only 2 non-orthogonal states (|0> and |+>) instead of 4. Bob's conclusive measurements yield key bits. Simpler but lower key rate than BB84.

algorithms.name: BB84 Quantum Key Distribution
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: BB84 QKD protocol: Alice encodes bits in randomly chosen bases; Bob measures to establish shared secret key.

algorithms.name: Bell State
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Create a maximally entangled Bell pair (|00> + |11>) / sqrt(2) using a Hadamard gate followed by a CNOT.

algorithms.name: Bernstein-Vazirani Algorithm
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Recover a hidden binary string s=101 from f(x) = s*x (mod 2) in a single query.

algorithms.name: Bit-Flip Code
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: 3-qubit repetition code that encodes 1 logical qubit and corrects single bit-flip errors.

algorithms.name: Classical Tensor Network Simulation
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Simulate quantum circuits classically using tensor network contraction. Handles 30-50 qubit circuits that are too large for statevector simulation but have limited entanglement depth. Uses quimb/cotengra for optimal contraction path finding. Serves as a classical baseline for comparison with quantum hardware results.

algorithms.name: Cluster State Preparation
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Prepare a 4-qubit linear cluster state for measurement-based quantum computation.

algorithms.name: Deutsch-Jozsa Algorithm
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Determine whether a 3-bit Boolean function is constant or balanced in one query.

algorithms.name: Drug-Target Docking Score (VQE)
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Estimate drug-target binding affinity using VQE for the interaction Hamiltonian between a small molecule and protein binding site. Requires quantum chemistry stack to compute molecular interaction Hamiltonians from 3D geometry. Qubit Pharmaceuticals (ATLAS platform) uses similar approach with GPU+QM hybrid. Well beyond hardcoded Pauli strings — needs full electronic structure pipeline.

algorithms.name: E91 Entanglement-Based QKD
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Simulate the E91 QKD protocol (Ekert, 1991). Uses shared Bell pairs for key distribution. Alice and Bob measure in different bases — matching bases yield key bits, non-matching bases test the CHSH Bell inequality. Violation of CHSH (S > 2) proves the quantum channel is secure; S <= 2 indicates eavesdropping.

algorithms.name: Entanglement Swapping
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Create entanglement between two qubits that never directly interact, via entanglement swapping.

algorithms.name: Quantum Error Detection
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Detect any single-qubit error using 4 physical qubits encoding 2 logical qubits.

algorithms.name: GHZ Secret Sharing
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: 3-party quantum secret sharing using a GHZ state: requires cooperation to recover secret.

algorithms.name: GHZ State
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Create a three-qubit Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger state (|000> + |111>) / sqrt(2), a maximally entangled multi-qubit state.

algorithms.name: Grover's Search Algorithm
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Quadratic speedup for unstructured search: finds target among N items in O(sqrt(N)) queries.

algorithms.name: Hadamard Test
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Estimate Re(<psi|U|psi>) for U=Z gate using a single ancilla qubit.

algorithms.name: HHL Algorithm
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Solve Ax=b for a 2x2 system using the Harrow-Hassidim-Lloyd algorithm.

algorithms.name: Phase-Flip Code
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: 3-qubit code that corrects single phase-flip (Z) errors by encoding in the X basis.

algorithms.name: Phase Kickback
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Demonstrate the phase kickback trick: a CNOT with ancilla in |- > imprints a phase on the control qubit.

algorithms.name: Protein Folding via Annealing (QUBO)
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Solve simplified protein folding using QUBO formulation on a coarse-grained lattice model. Maps amino acid sequences to lattice positions, minimizes energy via annealing. Research-grade problem — even toy proteins (5-8 amino acids) require 50+ QUBO variables. Menten AI (D-Wave) demonstrated this approach for peptide design. Requires validated QUBO formulation for lattice protein models.

algorithms.name: Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA)
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Approximate combinatorial optimization using alternating problem and mixer unitaries. This 4-qubit example targets a MaxCut problem on a 4-node ring graph with p=1.

algorithms.name: QAOA - Graph Coloring
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Solve graph coloring using QAOA with QUBO penalty encoding. N nodes with K colors use N*K binary variables. One-hot constraint per node (exactly one color) plus penalty for same-color adjacent nodes. Practical for 4 nodes x 3 colors (12 qubits).

algorithms.name: QAOA MaxCut
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (p=1) for MaxCut on a graph.

algorithms.name: QAOA - Travelling Salesman Problem
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Solve the Travelling Salesman Problem using QAOA with QUBO penalty encoding. N cities are mapped to N^2 binary variables (x_{i,p} = city i at position p). Constraints enforce each city visited once and each position filled once. Practical for 3 cities (9 qubits). Based on Lucas, Frontiers in Physics 2:5 (2014).

algorithms.name: QAOA - Vehicle Routing Problem
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Solve the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) via QAOA with QUBO encoding. Multiple vehicles serve customers from a depot, minimizing total distance. Generalization of TSP with capacity constraints. QUBO formulation scales fast (N customers × K vehicles × T time steps). Practical only when simulator handles 20+ qubits efficiently.

algorithms.name: Quantum Fourier Transform
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: 4-qubit QFT: the quantum analogue of the discrete Fourier transform.

algorithms.name: Quantum Phase Estimation
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Estimate the eigenphase of the T gate using 3 counting qubits.

algorithms.name: Quantum Random Number Generator
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Generate truly random bits using quantum superposition and measurement.

algorithms.name: Quantum Half-Adder
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Reversible quantum half-adder: computes sum and carry for 1-bit inputs using Toffoli gates.

algorithms.name: Quantum Coin Flipping
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Fair coin flipping over a quantum channel: Alice and Bob each contribute randomness via entanglement.

algorithms.name: Quantum Counting
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Count solutions to a 2-qubit oracle using QPE applied to Grover's operator.

algorithms.name: Quantum Fingerprinting
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Exponentially compress a classical string into a quantum fingerprint for equality testing.

algorithms.name: Discrete Quantum Walk
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: 2-step discrete quantum walk on a 4-node cycle using Hadamard coin.

algorithms.name: Repetition Code
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: The simplest quantum error-correcting code. Encodes one logical qubit into 5 physical qubits (distance 3) with 4 syndrome ancillas to detect single bit-flip errors.

algorithms.name: Shor's 9-Qubit Code
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: First quantum error-correcting code: encodes 1 logical qubit into 9 physical qubits.

algorithms.name: Shor's Period Finding
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Core period-finding subroutine of Shor's algorithm: find the period r of f(x) = 7^x mod 15.

algorithms.name: Simon's Algorithm
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Find the hidden period s=11 of a 2-to-1 function with exponential quantum speedup.

algorithms.name: Steane [[7,1,3]] Code
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: First CSS code: encodes 1 logical qubit in 7 physical qubits, corrects any single-qubit error.

algorithms.name: Surface Code
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: The rotated surface code on a 3x3 grid (distance 3). Uses 9 data qubits and 8 syndrome ancillas with nearest-neighbor connectivity. The dominant QEC code for superconducting hardware.

algorithms.name: SWAP Test
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Measure state overlap between two quantum states using a Fredkin gate.

algorithms.name: Quantum Teleportation
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Teleport the state of qubit 0 to qubit 2 using a pre-shared Bell pair and classical communication.

algorithms.name: Trotter-Ising Simulation
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: One first-order Trotter step simulating the 1D transverse-field Ising model on 4 qubits.

algorithms.name: Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE)
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Find the ground-state energy of a Hamiltonian using a parameterized ansatz and classical optimizer. This minimal H2 example uses a single Ry rotation.

algorithms.name: VQE Hardware-Efficient Ansatz
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: 4-qubit hardware-efficient variational ansatz for VQE with Ry-Rz-CNOT layers.

algorithms.name: VQE - Beryllium Hydride (BeH2) Ground State
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Find the ground state energy of beryllium hydride (BeH2) using the Variational Quantum Eigensolver. Uses a 6-qubit parity-mapped Hamiltonian with 15 representative Pauli terms from the STO-3G basis at ~1.3 A bond length. Demonstrates VQE scaling from 2 qubits (H2) to 4 qubits (LiH) to 6 qubits (BeH2). The full Hamiltonian has 164 terms (Kandala et al., Nature 549, 242, 2017).

algorithms.name: VQE - Bond Length Potential Energy Scan
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Scan ground state energy across multiple bond lengths to map the potential energy surface. Runs VQE at each geometry point and plots energy vs distance. Requires dynamic Hamiltonian generation at each bond length — needs a chemistry library to compute molecular integrals.

algorithms.name: VQE - Water Molecule (H2O) Ground State
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Find the ground state energy of water (H2O) using VQE. Requires 8-12 qubits depending on basis set and orbital reduction. Full Hamiltonian needs Qiskit Nature for dynamic generation from molecular geometry — too large to hardcode.

algorithms.name: VQE - Hubbard Model Lattice Simulation
algorithms.author: iniestarchen
algorithms.description: Simulate the Fermi-Hubbard model on a small lattice using VQE. The Hubbard model describes electron interactions in materials — fundamental to understanding superconductivity, magnetism, and strongly correlated systems. Jordan-Wigner mapping at useful lattice sizes requires Qiskit Nature. A 2-site model (4 qubits) could be hardcoded as educational.
